Report on the health of supported sources

Source: R/status.R
knbs_status.Rd

Answers two different questions depending on live. With live = FALSE it reports what the package knows about each source without contacting anything. With live = TRUE it asks each verified source to answer a small request and reports what happened.

Usage

knbs_status(source = NULL, live = interactive(), timeout = 10)

Arguments

source

Source ids to check. Defaults to every registered source.

live

Whether to contact the sources. Defaults to interactive(), so that automated runs never depend on a live service.

timeout

Request timeout in seconds, applied only to this call.

Value

A tibble with one row per source and columns source_id, operation, status, http_status, response_time_ms, checked_at and message.

Details

The status column is one of:

ok

The source answered.

unavailable

The source was contacted and did not answer usefully. The message column says why.

unverified

The source's endpoint has not been verified, so there is nothing to contact. It is never checked live.

not_checked

The source could have been checked, but live was FALSE.

See also

knbs_sources() for what each source supports.

Examples

# Offline: reports what the registry knows, contacts nothing.
knbs_status()
#> # A tibble: 7 × 7
#>   source_id    operation status http_status response_time_ms checked_at         
#>   <chr>        <chr>     <chr>        <int>            <dbl> <dttm>             
#> 1 kenada       search_s… not_c…          NA               NA 2026-10-05 21:28:56
#> 2 knbs_public… search_p… not_c…          NA               NA 2026-10-05 21:28:56
#> 3 knbs_indica… list_ind… not_c…          NA               NA 2026-10-05 21:28:56
#> 4 knbs_cpi     list_ind… not_c…          NA               NA 2026-10-05 21:28:56
#> 5 knbs_openda… list_ind… not_c…          NA               NA 2026-10-05 21:28:56
#> 6 opendatafor… list_ind… not_c…          NA               NA 2026-10-05 21:28:56
#> 7 fake_source  search_s… unver…          NA               NA 2026-10-05 21:28:56
#> # ℹ 1 more variable: message <chr>

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Contacts each verified source.
knbs_status(live = TRUE)
} # }
